name: com.velvetrituals/developer-docs
title: Velvet Developer Docs
description: Docs, code patterns and device kinds for the Velvet Bluetooth device SDK and Velvet Live API.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search over the Velvet developer docs (Toy SDK and Velvet Live). Returns the best-matching sections as Markdown, each with its source URL. Use get_doc for a whole page.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "vibrate durationMs" or "mint model token"

product.description: toys = Toy SDK, live = Velvet Live (cam sites)

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: One whole page of the Velvet developer docs as Markdown (the same text as /docs/<page>.md). Pages: quickstart (Quickstart), keys (Keys), sdk (SDK reference), tracks (Sync to video and audio), safety (Safety), browser-support (Browser and platform support), intiface (Use Velvet toys with Intiface), live/quickstart (Velvet Live quickstart), live/server-api (Server API), live/live-js (live.js), live/menu (The tip menu), live/errors (Errors), live/embedding (Iframe & browsers), ai-tools (Use with AI tools), changelog (Changelog).

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description: Ready-made toy patterns from the Velvet cookbook (tease, wave, heartbeat, …) with the exact SDK code for each, the toy kind it needs and the limits it respects.

kind.description: Only recipes for this toy kind (vibration = every toy)

tools.name: get_toy_kinds
tools.description: The four Velvet toy kinds (vibration, dual motor, suction, heat), which models fall under each, a capability-checked example call per kind, and the SDK command limits.
